result.topic_en: Gauss computes cubic periods (Gaussian sums over cubic residues) for the prime 19 using a primitive cube root of unity R, giving products and cubes of the period sums and a table of indices modulo 19.

methods.what: Definition of the cubic Lagrange resolvent / Gauss sum [r,R] with r an n-th root of unity, R a cube root of unity, weighted by index
Square of the resolvent expressed via Jacobi-type sum over indices
Cube of the resolvent equals n times a Jacobi sum
Numerical evaluation of the Jacobi sum for n = 19
Table of indices (discrete logarithms) modulo 19 with cubic class marks
Cubic periods combined with cube roots of unity and the product qq'
Geometric-type sum of powers of R
